summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting the open-market repurchase of 22,287,487 ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of 98.1324 pence per share on 30 April 2026. The buyback forms part of an existing £1.75 billion share buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026. Shares were purchased from Goldman Sachs International and will be cancelled. Since the programme's commencement, the company has repurchased a total of 790,748,189 shares for £772,975,684.16. No board recommendation or advisor is mentioned. The filing is a routine transaction update, not a new special situation, but the ongoing large-scale buyback itself constitutes a capital return event. Watch for monthly purchase updates and any programme modifications.
